segments.name: wholesale operations
segments.description: Sells apparel and other products to retailers under owned, licensed and private label brands, including Vilebrequin and Karl Lagerfeld businesses and licensing royalty income.
segments.evidence: The wholesale operations segment includes sales of products to retailers under owned, licensed and private label brands, as well as sales related to the Vilebrequin and Karl Lagerfeld businesses, including from retail stores operated by Vilebrequin and Karl Lagerfeld, other than sales of product under the Karl Lagerfeld Paris brand generated by the Company's retail stores and digital platforms.

segments.name: retail operations
segments.description: Sells proprietary brand products directly to consumers through company operated outlet stores and digital channels.
segments.evidence: The retail operations segment consists primarily of direct sales to consumers through Company operated stores, which consists primarily of DKNY and Karl Lagerfeld Paris stores, as well as the digital channels for DKNY, Donna Karan, Karl Lagerfeld Paris, G.H. Bass and Wilsons Leather.

revenueModel.text: Retailers and consumers pay G-III for apparel and other products sold at wholesale and through company operated stores and digital platforms, and licensees pay royalties for use of owned brand trademarks.
revenueModel.evidence: Wholesale revenues also include revenues from license agreements related to trademarks associated with the Company's owned brands.
